paite: Huan David in akiang a om mite asim a, sepaih sangkhat tung a heutute, zakhat tung a heutute abawl hi.
heading: Absalom Zoh Leh Thah In A-om

paite: David in mite asawlkhia a, mun thum a khen mun khat Joab in aheu a, mun thum a khen mun khat Joab unaupa Zeruiah tapa, Abishai in aheu a, mun thum a khen mun khat Git mi Ittai in aheu hi. Kumpipa'n mite kiang ah, "Keimah leng nou toh ka kuan ngeingei ding," achi hi.

Himahleh mipite'n, "Kuan lou e. Koute zaw na taimang hita le ung leng, khawk asa kei ding uh. Akimkhat hiam va si le ung leng khawk asa kei lai ding uh. Nang koute singkhat sang in na manphazaw hi. Huaiziak in khopi a pan hon panpih dia na na om ahoihzaw hi," achi uh.
Kumpipa'n akiang uah, "Hoih na sak bangbang un ka hih ding," achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa kulh kongpi bul ah adingh a, mipi tengteng azaza in leh asangsang in apaikhe zungzung uhi.

Kumpipa'n Joab, Abishai leh Ittai kiang ah, kei ziak in tangval Absalom tung ah nemtak in hih un aw, chi in thu apia hi. Mipi tengteng in Absalom tungtang thu a kumpipa'n sepaih heutute tengteng thu apiak lai aza uhi.
Huchi in mipite Israel mite dou ding in kidouna mun ah ahohta ua; akidouna uh Ephraim gammang ahi.
Huai ah David mite ma ah Israel mite avuallel ua, huai ni in sepaih singnih athat uhi.
Akidouna un huai gam tengteng a-uap vek ngal a. Huai ni in namsau sang in leng gammang sung a mang a si atamzaw hi.

Absalom in David mite abingtuah guih hi. Absalom asabiltung tung a tuang ahi a, tosaw singhiang bawkphatak nuai ah sabiltung alut a, tosaw sing ah alu a-awkta hi. Lei leh van kikal ah aluai nilouh hi. Sabiltung ataisuak hi,
Kuahiam in mu in, Joab ahilh a, "Ngai in, tosaw sing ah Absalom kikhai nilouh ka mu,” achi hi.
Joab in ahilhpa kiang ah, "Ngai in, huai lah na mu ngal a, bangziak a hihlum a lei a kesak pah ngal lou? Huchibang a hih hi lechin dangka sawm leh kawnggak hon pe pah ding hi veng in," achi hi.

Huai mi'n Joab kiang ah, "Dangka sang mu ding hi leng le kumpipa tapa tung ah ka khut ka kha kei himhim ding, i bil ua i zak mahmah in kumpipa'n nang leh Abishai leh Ittai kiang ah, tangval Absalom kuamah in khoih het kei un, chi in thu ahon pe ngal a.
Ginom huai loutak in na that mawk leng, kumpipa lak ah lah bangmah sel theih ahi ngal kei a, nang lah na kihulsak nawn maimah tuak ngal a," achi hi.
Huchi in Joab in, "Hichibang in na kiang ah ka om nilouh thei het kei," achi hi. Teipi thum atawi a, tosaw sing lak a na hing lai Absalom lungtang adawt pailet hi.
Joab galvan tawi tangval sawm in ahong um ua, Absalom asun ua, athatta uhi.
Joab in pengkul amut a, Israelte delh mipite ahong kik nawn ua; Joab in mite ana nang bikbek hi.
Absalom luang ala ua, gammang ah leihawm thukpi ah apai ua, atung ah suang asekhawm venvon uhi. Huchi in Israel mi tengteng amau puanin chiat ah ataikekta uhi.

Absalom in adam lai in kumpipa phaizang ah amah theihgigena ding suang ana phut khin hi. Ka min adailouhna ding tapa lah ka nei ngal kei a, chi in ama min atamsak hi. Huchi in tuni tan in hiai Absalom theihgigena suangphuh chih in a-om hi.
Huchi in Zadok tapa Ahimaaz in, "Ka va tai dia, TOUPA'N amelma phu alaksakdan tanchin kumpipa ka va hilh ding," achi hi.
heading: Absalom Sih Thu David Hilh In A-om

paite: Joab in akiang ah, "Tuni in zaw tanchin va hilh nai ke'n. Nidang chiang in tanchin va hilh zaw in, kumpipa tapa asih ziak in, tuni in zaw tanchin bangmah va hilh dah in," achi hi.
Joab in Kush mi kiang ah, "Kuan inla, na thil muh kumpipa va hilh dih ve," achi hi. Huchi in Kush mi akun a, ataikhe pah hi.
Zadok tapa Ahimaaz in Joab kiang ah, "Akoi abang hitaleh, Kush mipa ka va delh ding," achi hi. Joab in, "Ka tapa aw, tanchin hilh man lah na mu kei dia, bangziak a tai ding na hia?" achi hi.
Himahleh ama'n, "Akoi abang hitaleh ka tai ding," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Tai mai ve leh," achi hi. Huchi in Phaizang lampi ah Ahimaaz atai a, Kush mipa amakhelh hi.
Kulh kongpi chial kikal ah David ana tu hi. Galvilpa kulh kongpi ponungzaw pen tunglam ah apaitou a, adak vialvial hi. Ngai in, mi khat amah kia in ahong tai hi.
Galvilpa akikou a, kumpipa ahilh hi. Kumpipa'n, "Mi khat kia ahihleh tanchin hong gen ding nei ahi ding," achi a; ahong tai mengmeng a, ahong naih hiaihiai hi.
Galvilpa'n midang hong tai amu nawn hi. Galvilpa'n kongkhak vilpa asam a, "Ngai in, midang amah kia in ahong tai nawn," achi hi. Kumpipa'n, "Ama'n leng tanchin hong tun sam ding nei ahi ve," achi hi.
Galvilpa'n, "Amasapen taidan Zadok tapa Ahimaaz taidan bang mahmah in ka thei," achi hi. Huan kumpipa'n, "Amah mihoih mahmah ahi, tanchinhoih hon tun ding ahi," achi hi.
Ahimaaz in asam a, kumpipa kiang ah, "Bangkim ahoih e," achi hi. Amai a lei si in kumpipa ma a kun in, "TOUPA, ka toupa sual a khut khak tum mite daltanpa TOUPA na Pathian phat in om hen," achi hi.

Kumpipa'n, "Tangval Absalom adam na maw?" achi hi. Ahimaaz in adawng a, "Joab in kumpipa sikha, kei na sikha mahmah ahon sawlkhiak lai in abuai nuainuai uh ka mu a, himahleh bang ahia chih ka thei kei," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n, "Ka pam ah hong dingh tadih in,” achi hi. Huchi in apam ah ana dingh hi.
Ngai in, Kush mi ahong tung hi. Kush mi'n, "Toupa ka kumpipa a ding in tanchin ka hon tun hi. Na tung a helte tengteng phu tuni in TOUPA'N ahon laksak hi," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n Kush mi kiang ah, "Tangval Absalom adam na maw?" achi hi. Kush mi in adawng a, "Toupa, ka kumpipa melmate leh na siatna zong mite tengteng huai tangval bang in om vek uheh," achi hi.

Huchi in kumpipa alungdong mahmah a, kulh kongpi tung a dantan ah ahohtou a ava kap hi. Apaitouh kawm in, "Aw, ka tapa Absalom, ka tapa Absalom, na sih sik in si zaw mai leng maw, Aw Absalom, ka tapa, ka tapa," achi hi.
